changelog: Optional custom manifest — only needed if you later host your own update JSON.
Default Desktop channel is GitHub Releases (zavorth/zavorth), no website required.
releaseNotes: Most users should leave ZAVORTH_UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL unset and use GitHub Releases.
notes: Override with ZAVORTH_UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL only if you publish a private JSON. Otherwise Desktop queries api.github.com/repos/zavorth/zavorth/releases/latest.
